versions.changelog:
- Initial release of NFT Floor Sweep Calculator.
- Calculates estimated total cost to sweep N NFTs off a collection's floor on Solana (Magic Eden) or EVM chains (CoinGecko) using live floor prices.
- Supports customizable per-item slippage and marketplace fees.
- Outputs subtotal, fee breakdown, average price per item, and total estimated spend.
- Does not require API keys; works with free, public endpoints.
- For planning and research only; does not execute trades or manage wallets.
